key: I come up here to train my body and mind against the cold... and against you! Hah!!!
en: I come up here to train my body and mind against the cold... and against you! Hah!!!
ja: ここに　来て　寒さに　立ち向かい　心と体を　鍛えてるんだ……　そして　お前とも　だ! ハッ!!!

key: Hmph. It seems I still have a ways to go.
en: Hmph. It seems I still have a ways to go.
ja: シール: ふん。まだまだ　修行が　足りんようだな。

key: What must you have endured to find such strength?
en: What must you have endured to find such strength?
ja: その強さを　手に入れるまでに　一体　何を　耐え抜いてきたんだ?

key: Oh-ho! You're the one who woke me before, no?
en: Oh-ho! You're the one who woke me before, no?
ja: おおっと! 前に　おれを　起こしてくれたのは　お前だな?

key: So we meet out here as well!
en: So we meet out here as well!
ja: こんなとこでも　また　会うとはな!

key: What do you say to a battle, friend?
en: What do you say to a battle, friend?
ja: 友よ　バトルと　いくか?

key: I know of no better way to enjoy nature!
en: I know of no better way to enjoy nature!
ja: 自然を　楽しむのに　これ以上の方法を　おれは　知らんぞ!

key: Splendid! Let's begin!
en: Splendid! Let's begin!
ja: 素晴らしい! さあ　始めよう!

key: Not bad, friend! You know how to live the natural world to its fullest extent!
en: Not bad, friend! You know how to live the natural world to its fullest extent!
ja: カリム: 悪くないな　友よ! お前は　自然の世界を　思う存分　生きる術を　知ってるようだな!

key: Whoo! I'm beat after that battle!
en: Whoo! I'm beat after that battle!
ja: ふう! あのバトルで　すっかり　疲れたぜ!

key: I think I'll let my Pokémon out to rest for a bit.
en: I think I'll let my Pokémon out to rest for a bit.
ja: 少し　ポケモンたちを　外に　出して　休ませようと思う。

key: You're something fierce, you know that?
en: You're something fierce, you know that?
ja: お前　なかなか　手強いな　知ってたか?

key: A true pity!
en: A true pity!
ja: 実に　残念だ!

key: If ever you change your mind, I won't stray far for some time!
en: If ever you change your mind, I won't stray far for some time!
ja: 気が　変わったら　いつでも　言ってくれ　しばらくは　遠くへは　行かないからな!

key: My Pokémon are all very friendly!
en: My Pokémon are all very friendly!
ja: うちのポケモンたちは　みんな　人懐っこいんだ!

key: Feel free to say "Hello" to them!
en: Feel free to say "Hello" to them!
ja: 遠慮なく「こんにちは」って　言ってやってくれ!

key: In fact, here--
en: In fact, here--
ja: そうだ　これを――

key: \PN received 5 PokéSnax!
en: \PN received 5 PokéSnax!
ja: \PNは　ポケスナックを5個　受け取った!

key: Give 'em a bite! They'll like you more!
en: Give 'em a bite! They'll like you more!
ja: 一口　あげてみてくれ! きっと　もっと　好かれるぞ!

key: You know, it may not have shown in that battle, but my Throh's gotten a lot stronger lately.
en: You know, it may not have shown in that battle, but my Throh's gotten a lot stronger lately.
ja: あのバトルじゃ　あまり　見せられなかったが　うちのナゲキは　最近　ずいぶん　強くなったんだ。

key: I know that Throh change their belts as they rank up, but it hasn't had much opportunity to do so.
en: I know that Throh change their belts as they rank up, but it hasn't had much opportunity to do so.
ja: ナゲキは　ランクが　上がると　帯を　変えるって　聞くが　まだ　あまり　その機会が　なくてな。

key: If you end up finding a spare belt, would you be willing to donate it for a wanting Pokémon?
en: If you end up finding a spare belt, would you be willing to donate it for a wanting Pokémon?
ja: もし　余分な帯を　見つけたら　欲しがってる　ポケモンのために　譲ってもらえないか?

key: Oh, you have a Black Belt even now!
en: Oh, you have a Black Belt even now!
ja: おお　今　くろおびを　持ってるじゃないか!

key: Will you let my Throh have it?
en: Will you let my Throh have it?
ja: うちのナゲキに　譲ってくれるか?

key: \PN handed over the Black Belt.
en: \PN handed over the Black Belt.
ja: \PNは　くろおびを　渡した。

key: Hm, no matter! We'll find our own.
en: Hm, no matter! We'll find our own.
ja: うーん　構わない! 自分たちで　探すさ。

key: Oh, you have an Expert Belt even now!
en: Oh, you have an Expert Belt even now!
ja: おお　今　たつじんのおびを　持ってるじゃないか!

key: \PN handed over the Expert Belt.
en: \PN handed over the Expert Belt.
ja: \PNは　たつじんのおびを　渡した。

key: Throh! Did you hear that!
en: Throh! Did you hear that!
ja: ナゲキ! 聞いたか!

key: This Trainer found a new belt for you!
en: This Trainer found a new belt for you!
ja: このトレーナーが　お前のために　新しい帯を　見つけてくれたぞ!

key: Seems like he loves it!
en: Seems like he loves it!
ja: すっかり　気に入ったみたいだな!

key: Thanks so much, friend!
en: Thanks so much, friend!
ja: 本当に　ありがとう　友よ!

key: Here's a little thanks on behalf of my Pokémon!
en: Here's a little thanks on behalf of my Pokémon!
ja: うちのポケモンたちに　代わって　ちょっとした礼だ!

key: There's nothing quite like living, fighting, and thriving among nature!
en: There's nothing quite like living, fighting, and thriving among nature!
ja: 自然の中で　生き　戦い　たくましく　生きること――　これに　勝るものは　ないな!

key: I'm sure my Pokémon feel the same way!
en: I'm sure my Pokémon feel the same way!
ja: うちのポケモンたちも　きっと　同じ気持ちだろう!

key: Altaria is happily distracted with its food.
en: Altaria is happily distracted with its food.
ja: チルタリスは　食事に　夢中で　うれしそうだ。

key: Altaria is singing peacefully.
en: Altaria is singing peacefully.
ja: チルタリスは　穏やかに　歌っている。

key: Feed Altaria some PokéSnax?
en: Feed Altaria some PokéSnax?
ja: チルタリスに　ポケスナックを　あげますか?

key: \PN offered Altaria the PokéSnax.
en: \PN offered Altaria the PokéSnax.
ja: \PNは　チルタリスに　ポケスナックを　あげた。

key: Altaria took it happily!
en: Altaria took it happily!
ja: チルタリスは　うれしそうに　受け取った!

key: Rhyperior appears to be staring out across the mountains.
en: Rhyperior appears to be staring out across the mountains.
ja: ドサイドンは　山々を　見つめているようだ。

key: Feed Rhyperior some PokéSnax?
en: Feed Rhyperior some PokéSnax?
ja: ドサイドンに　ポケスナックを　あげますか?

key: \PN offered Rhyperior the PokéSnax.
en: \PN offered Rhyperior the PokéSnax.
ja: \PNは　ドサイドンに　ポケスナックを　あげた。

key: Rhyperior bowed and took it thankfully!
en: Rhyperior bowed and took it thankfully!
ja: ドサイドンは　頭を　下げて　感謝しながら　受け取った!

key: Throh appears to be doing some exercises.
en: Throh appears to be doing some exercises.
ja: ナゲキは　運動をしているようだ。

key: Feed Throh some PokéSnax?
en: Feed Throh some PokéSnax?
ja: ナゲキに　ポケスナックを　あげますか?

key: \PN offered Throh the PokéSnax.
en: \PN offered Throh the PokéSnax.
ja: \PNは　ナゲキに　ポケスナックを　あげた。

key: Throh nodded and wolfed down the PokéSnax!
en: Throh nodded and wolfed down the PokéSnax!
ja: ナゲキは　うなずいて　ポケスナックを　がつがつと　食べた!

key: Golem appears to be stretching its legs.
en: Golem appears to be stretching its legs.
ja: ゴローニャは　足を　伸ばしているようだ。

key: Feed Golem some PokéSnax?
en: Feed Golem some PokéSnax?
ja: ゴローニャに　ポケスナックを　あげますか?

key: \PN offered Golem the PokéSnax.
en: \PN offered Golem the PokéSnax.
ja: \PNは　ゴローニャに　ポケスナックを　あげた。

key: Golem ate them excitedly!
en: Golem ate them excitedly!
ja: ゴローニャは　興奮しながら　食べた!

key: It could hardly contain its happiness!
en: It could hardly contain its happiness!
ja: うれしさを　抑えきれない様子だ!

key: My goodness!
en: My goodness!
ja: なんてことだ!

key: What happened to you all!?
en: What happened to you all!?
ja: お前たち　一体　どうしたんだ!?

key: Oof!
en: Oof!
ja: うっ!

key: If everyone's gotten like this, I guess it's about time to pack up and head back.
en: If everyone's gotten like this, I guess it's about time to pack up and head back.
ja: みんな　こんな調子じゃ　そろそろ　片付けて　帰った方が　良さそうだな。

key: Sorry for the disturbance, friend!
en: Sorry for the disturbance, friend!
ja: お騒がせして　悪かったな　友よ!

key: They are normally better behaved, I swear!
en: They are normally better behaved, I swear!
ja: 普段は　もっと　行儀が　いいんだ　本当だぞ!

key: We'll see you around!
en: We'll see you around!
ja: また　会おう!

key: Kommo-o appears to be sleeping peacefully.
en: Kommo-o appears to be sleeping peacefully.
ja: ジャラランガは　穏やかに　眠っているようだ。

key: Feed Kommo-o some PokéSnax?
en: Feed Kommo-o some PokéSnax?
ja: ジャラランガに　ポケスナックを　あげますか?

key: \PN offered Kommo-o the PokéSnax.
en: \PN offered Kommo-o the PokéSnax.
ja: \PNは　ジャラランガに　ポケスナックを　あげた。

key: Kommo-o lazily opened its mouth for the PokéSnax to be tossed in!
en: Kommo-o lazily opened its mouth for the PokéSnax to be tossed in!
ja: ジャラランガは　だるそうに　口を開けて　ポケスナックを　放り込ませた!

key: Kommo-o went back to sleep.
en: Kommo-o went back to sleep.
ja: ジャラランガは　また　眠りに　戻った。

key: Throh is nodding appreciatively.
en: Throh is nodding appreciatively.
ja: ナゲキは　感謝するように　うなずいている。

key: Throh smiled and wolfed down the PokéSnax!
en: Throh smiled and wolfed down the PokéSnax!
ja: ナゲキは　笑って　ポケスナックを　がつがつと　食べた!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
